scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:workflows && npm run lint:lines && npm run lint:architecture && npm run lint:duplicates
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:android:collect && npm test
scripts.lint:js: npm run lint:android-games && node scripts/lint-ratchet.mjs eslint
scripts.lint:python: npm run lint:python:lines && npm run lint:python:e2e && npm run lint:python:visual && node scripts/lint-ratchet.mjs ruff
scripts.lint:python:e2e: uv run --no-project --with radon==6.0.1 python scripts/check_e2e_complexity.py && uvx --from ruff==0.15.12 ruff check e2e/mitmproxy scripts/check_e2e_complexity.py scripts/test_check_e2e_complexity.py --config ruff.toml --config 'lint.mccabe.max-complexity=6' --no-cache --ignore-noqa
scripts.lint:workflows: uvx --from actionlint-py==1.7.12.25 --with shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 actionlint -pyflakes= -ignore 'unexpected key "queue" for "concurrency" section'
scripts.lint:python:visual: uv run --no-project --with radon==6.0.1 python scripts/check_visual_complexity.py && uvx --from ruff==0.15.12 ruff check visual/cases/_shared/mitmproxy visual/cases/club/mitmproxy visual/cases/game-record/mitmproxy visual/cases/texas-holdem/mitmproxy visual/cases/zhajinhua/mitmproxy scripts/check_visual_complexity.py scripts/test_check_visual_complexity.py --config ruff.toml --config 'lint.mccabe.max-complexity=6' --no-cache --ignore-noqa
